/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

  (s.devices.filter (·.kind == k)).map (·.id)
/-- The devices a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those of the kind, and those whose kind the
    source cannot tell, which may be of it. -/
def deviceCandidates (s : Scene) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (s.devices.filter fun d => d.kind == k || d.unobservedKinds.contains k).map (·.id)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Signals emitted by road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def sig_turn_indicator (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option TurnIndicatorState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.turnIndicator)
def sig_brake_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.brakeLamp)
def sig_hazard (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.hazard)
def sig_headlamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HeadlampState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.headlamp)
def sig_position_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.positionLamp)
def sig_warning_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List WarningLamp) := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.warningLamps)
/-- A warning lamp of the given colour lit, in any mode or facing. -/
def sig_warning_lamp_colour (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : LampColour) : Option Bool :=
  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any (·.colour == c))
def sig_warning_lamp_shows (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : LampColour) (m : LampMode) : Option Bool :=
  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any fun l => l.colour == c && l.mode == m)
def sig_siren (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.siren)
def sig_horn (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.horn)
def sig_hand_signal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HandSignal := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.handSignal)
def sig_door_open (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List DoorSide) := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.doorsOpen)
def sig_door_open_side (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (side : DoorSide) : Option Bool := (sig_door_open s x).map (·.contains side)
def sig_compression_brake (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.compressionBrake)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Environment
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness
def env_precipitation (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.precipitation
def env_wet_road (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.wetRoad
def env_ice_or_snow (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.iceOrSnow
def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

2	  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
4	-/
5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
7	  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
8	  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
9	  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
10	  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
11	  arguments with no default.
12	
13	  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
14	  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
15	  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
16	-/
17	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
18	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate
22	
23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	namespace Primitives
25	open Temporal
26	
27	/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
28	    numerator and denominator. -/
29	def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
30	  | [], [] => true
31	  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
32	    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
33	  | _, _ => false
34	
35	theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
36	  | [], [], _ => rfl
37	  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
38	    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
39	    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
40	    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
41	    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
42	    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
43	    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
44	    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
45	  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
46	  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
47	
48	/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
49	    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
50	structure SimpleEntry where
51	  id : RegionId
52	  boundary : List Vec
53	  flag : Thunk Bool
54	  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary
55	
56	/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
57	    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
58	def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
59	  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
60	      match st.boundary with
61	      | none => acc
62	      | some b =>
63	        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
64	        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []
65	
66	/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
67	    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
68	    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
69	structure Ctx where
70	  scenes : Array Scene
71	  times : Array Q
72	  ρ : Reading
73	  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
74	  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
75	  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
76	  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
77	      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
78	  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes
79	
80	/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
81	    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
82	def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
83	  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
84	  | some e => e.flag.get
85	  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly
86	
87	/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
88	    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
89	theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
90	  unfold simpleIn
91	  split
92	  · rename_i e h
93	    have hp := List.find?_some h
94	    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
95	    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
96	  · rfl
97	
98	def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
99	  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
100	def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size
101	
102	/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
103	    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
104	inductive DArg
105	  | v (id : Nat)
106	  | s (lit : String)
107	  | n (nat : Nat)
108	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
109	
110	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
111	-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
112	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
113	def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
114	def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
115	def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
116	def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
117	def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
118	  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
119	def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
120	  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"
121	
122	def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
123	def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
124	  match o with | some q => .ok q | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
125	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
126	-- Scene-level helpers over atoms
127	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
128	/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
129	    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
130	def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
131	  let n := c.n
132	  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
133	  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
134	    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
135	    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
136	    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
137	      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
138	      | none => prev)) #[]
139	  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
140	  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
141	    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
142	  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
143	  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
144	    match wins[i]! with
145	    | none => .error .outOfRange
146	    | some win =>
147	      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
148	      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
149	      else
150	        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
151	        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
152	        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)
153	
154	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
155	-- The primitives
156	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
157	/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
158	def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
159	  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
160	  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute
161	
162	private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
163	  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)
164	
165	private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=
166	  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
167	
168	/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
169	    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
170	private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
171	  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
172	  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
173	  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
174	  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
175	  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
176	  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
177	  let vv := Geom.dot v v
178	  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
179	  else
180	    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
181	    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
182	    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))
183	
184	/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
185	    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
186	def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
187	  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
188	    | .error r => .error (match r with
189	        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
190	        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
191	        | other => other)
192	    | .ok Δ => .ok Δ

194	/-- The centres approach each other within the horizon. -/
195	def prim_closest_approach_within (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array R :=
196	  each c fun s => match closestApproach s a b horizon with
197	    | .error w => R.u w
198	    | .ok o => R.ofBool o.isSome

/-
  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
  arguments with no default.

  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Primitives
open Temporal

/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
    numerator and denominator. -/
def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
  | _, _ => false

theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
structure SimpleEntry where
  id : RegionId
  boundary : List Vec
  flag : Thunk Bool
  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary

/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | none => acc
      | some b =>
        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []

/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
structure Ctx where
  scenes : Array Scene
  times : Array Q
  ρ : Reading
  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes

/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
  | some e => e.flag.get
  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
  unfold simpleIn
  split
  · rename_i e h
    have hp := List.find?_some h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
  · rfl

def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size

/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
inductive DArg
  | v (id : Nat)
  | s (lit : String)
  | n (nat : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some q => .ok q | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Scene-level helpers over atoms
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
  let n := c.n
  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
      | none => prev)) #[]
  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => .error .outOfRange
    | some win =>
      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
      else
        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The primitives
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute

private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)

private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
  let vv := Geom.dot v v
  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
  else
    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
    | .error r => .error (match r with
        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
        | other => other)
    | .ok Δ => .ok Δ

/-- The centres approach each other within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_within (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array R :=
  each c fun s => match closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | .error w => R.u w
    | .ok o => R.ofBool o.isSome

/-- The time of closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
3	  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
4	  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.
5	
6	  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
7	  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
8	  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.
9	
10	  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
11	  writes through a `Units` constructor.
12	-/
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Build
17	
18	/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
19	def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
20	def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
21	def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
22	def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))
23	
24	def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)
25	
26	/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
27	    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
28	def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
29	    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
30	  { track := track
31	    classes := some classes
32	    kin := { position := some pos
33	             heading := some heading
34	             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
35	             speed := some speed
36	             extent := some halfExtent
37	             pathLength := pathLength } }
38	
39	/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
40	def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
41	  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }
42	
43	def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
44	def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
45	/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
46	def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
47	def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }
48	
49	/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
50	def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
51	  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
52	/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
53	def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
54	  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
55	/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
56	def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
57	    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
58	    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
59	  { id := id
60	    kind := .lane
61	    boundary := some boundary
62	    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
63	                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
64	                   entersIntersection := enters } }
65	def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
66	  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }
67	
68	def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
69	  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
70	def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
71	  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
72	def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
73	def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
74	  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
75	def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
76	    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
77	  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }
78	
79	/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
80	def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
81	  users.flatMap fun u =>
82	    match u.kin.position with
83	    | none => []
84	    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
85	      match st.boundary with
86	      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
87	      | none => none
88	
89	/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
90	def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
91	    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
92	    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
93	  { t := t
94	    subject := subject
95	    users := users
96	    structures := structures
97	    devices := devices
98	    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
99	    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
100	    env := env
101	    assumptions := assumptions
102	    intents := intents }
103	
104	/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
105	def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
106	  (List.range n).map fun k =>
107	    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
108	      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
109	    f k t
110	
111	/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
112	    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
113	def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
114	  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
115	  | some first, some last =>
116	    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
117	    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
118	    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
119	    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
120	    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
121	    pre ++ τ ++ post
122	  | _, _ => τ
123	
124	def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ
125	
126	/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
127	def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
128	  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
129	  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }
130	
131	end Build
132	
133	/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
134	    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
135	    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
136	    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
137	    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
138	    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
139	    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
140	    far enough to decide it. -/
141	structure Scenario where
142	  name : String
143	  rule : String
144	  trace : Trace
145	  reading : Reading
146	  manifest : Manifest
147	  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
148	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
149	  expected : Verdict
150	  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
151	  boundary : String := ""
152	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
153	
154	namespace Scenario
155	/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
156	    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
157	def pastOps : List String :=
158	  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
159	   "heading_since"]
160	
161	/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
162	    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
163	    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
164	    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
165	    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
166	    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
168	    `unknown` witness only.
169	    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
171	def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
172	  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
173	  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
174	    | some r => pure r
175	    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
176	  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
177	    | .ok S => pure S
178	    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
179	  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
180	    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
181	      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
182	  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
183	  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
184	  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
185	    match sc.window with
186	    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
187	    | none => true
188	  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
189	  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
190	    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
191	  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
192	    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
193	  match sc.expected with
194	  | .notApplicable =>
195	    if tl.present then pure got
196	    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
197	  | .unknown _ =>
198	    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
199	    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
200	    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
201	      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
202	      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
203	    if !stray.isEmpty then
204	      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
205	    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
206	      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
207	    else pure got
208	  | _ => pure got
209	end Scenario
210	
211	end TrafficSpec

import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
3	  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.
4	
5	  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
6	  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
7	  drop them once a value is decided.
8	-/
9	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
10	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
11	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles
12	
13	namespace TrafficSpec
14	
15	inductive UnknownReason
16	  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
17	  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
18	  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
19	  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
20	  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
21	  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
22	  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
23	  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
24	  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
25	  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
26	  | divisionByZero (what : String)
27	  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
28	  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
29	  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	namespace UnknownReason
33	/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
34	def tag : UnknownReason → String
35	  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
36	  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
37	  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
38	  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
39	  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
40	  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
41	  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
42	  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
43	  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
44	  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
45	  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
46	  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
47	  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
48	  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
49	instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
50	end UnknownReason
51	
52	/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
53	structure R where
54	  v : Tri
55	  why : List UnknownReason := []
56	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
57	
58	namespace R
59	def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
60	def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
61	def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
62	def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
63	def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
64	  match o with
65	  | some b => ofBool b
66	  | none => u w
67	/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
68	def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
69	@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
70	def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
71	def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
72	def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
73	@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
74	@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
75	@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
76	def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
77	def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
78	def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
79	/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
80	def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
81	  match o with
82	  | some a => k a
83	  | none => u w
84	end R
85	
86	/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
87	abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q
88	
89	/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
90	    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
91	structure RangeAgg where
92	  vals : Array R
93	  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
94	  prefT : Array Nat
95	  prefU : Array Nat
96	  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)
97	
98	namespace RangeAgg
99	def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
100	  let n := vals.size
101	  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
102	    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
103	  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
104	    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
105	  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩
106	
107	private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
108	private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
109	  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
110	  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []
111	
112	/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
113	def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
114	  if hi < lo then R.t
115	  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
116	  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
117	  else R.t
118	/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
119	def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
120	  if hi < lo then R.f
121	  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
122	  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
123	  else R.f
124	
125	/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
126	def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
127	  | 0 => 0
128	  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)
129	
130	private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
131	    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
132	    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
133	      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
134	  induction k with
135	  | zero => simp [countTo]
136	  | succ k ih =>
137	    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
138	    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
139	    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
140	    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
141	    split
142	    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
143	    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
144	      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]
145	
146	theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
147	    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
148	  induction b with
149	  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
150	  | succ b ih =>
151	    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
152	    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
153	    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
154	      exact Nat.le_refl _
155	
156	/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
157	theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
158	    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
159	  constructor
160	  · intro h
161	    induction n with
162	    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
163	    | succ n ih =>
164	      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
165	      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
166	        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
167	        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
168	      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
169	        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
170	        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
171	  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
172	    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
173	    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
174	    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
175	    omega
176	
177	private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
178	    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
179	  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
180	  simp only [cnt, build]
181	  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]
182	
183	/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
184	theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
185	    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
186	  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
187	    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
188	    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
189	    exact absurd h (by decide)
190	  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
191	    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
192	    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
193	    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
194	  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
195	    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
196	    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
197	    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
198	      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
199	      rw [hf.1]; omega
200	    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
201	    omega
202	  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
203	  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
204	  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩
205	
206	/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
207	theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
208	    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
209	  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
210	    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
211	    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
212	    omega
213	  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
214	end RangeAgg
215	
216	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.

  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
  drop them once a value is decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason
  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
  match o with
  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
  prefT : Array Nat
  prefU : Array Nat
  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)

namespace RangeAgg
def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size
  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩

private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
    omega

private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
  simp only [cnt, build]
  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]

/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
      rw [hf.1]; omega
    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
    omega
  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
    omega
  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
end RangeAgg

end TrafficSpec
